reason: The cited articles (10, 12, 13, 26(6)) collectively address data governance, transparency, and record-keeping, which provide a defensible basis for requiring configurable retention and deletion of AI system data.
applicability_note: This control is applicable to all AI systems under the EU AI Act, as it pertains to fundamental data management practices.
challenge_comment: The mapping is broad but sufficient; the articles do not need to specify the exact data types (prompts, files, etc.) to support the control objective.
